title: 'Offworld technology' sign on the wall at Crane
summary: Randy Anderson tells of 'Offworld technology' sign on the wall at Crane, about 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: got into an area that had a marking on the wall and said offworld technology said offworld technology

plain: Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology at a military site, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2014 he was at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research and testing base in Indiana. He says he entered an area with a marking on the wall that read "offworld technology." If true, it would mean the Navy openly labeled a space at the base for technology not made on Earth.
